text: LANE B UPDATE + THE DUPLICATE-PRICE ESCALATION IS ANSWERABLE WITHOUT SAMUEL. Exact SHA 2e0e209bbf0fbb45b79b5d208732466975670b5d on lane/peptide-payment-generalization-20260821 (base c371201). 33 tests, tsc clean, no production mutation, new files only in server/research/early-access/release/. (1) TWO CORRECTIONS TO MY OWN 510bc4b, from the founder's 2026-08-21 rules: 'held' is now 'commerceHold' and the contract states that supplier/inventory/lot/COA/fulfillment readiness must NEVER be wired into it - my earlier doc comment said 'Product Control blocker', and a PC blocker set contains exactly those operational states, so as documented the gate would have refused orders the founder said to ACCEPT, silently, showing 'not available' for an available product. The test now proves it structurally: the gate has no input named supplierAssigned/inventoryConfirmed/lotAssigned/coaOnFile/fulfillmentReady/releasedUnit, so it cannot consider them. (2) WITH-DAC pinned row by row so the hold cannot be broadened: GRP-0272 2mg 00 ADMITTED, GRP-0273 5mg 87.50 ADMITTED, GRP-0394 10mg refused CLASSIFICATION (not composition), GRP-0422 refused COMPOSITION, No-DAC combos GRP-0268/0269/0270/0271 ADMITTED, plus a sweep proving GRP-0422 is the ONLY row of all 426 refused for composition. (3) THE COLLAPSE DECISION - please read, it unblocks Samuel. The pairs disagree on CLASSIFICATION as well as price: GRP-0426 HEXARELIN 5mg RUO 49.00 vs GRP-0402 pending 62.50; GRP-0425 OXYTOCIN 10mg RUO 59.00 vs GRP-0407 pending 107.50. So the collapse decides whether the product is buyable at all, not just its price. But it needs no new decision, because only ONE resolution satisfies both founder targets: 111 direct = 112 RUO minus the 1 composition-blocked row, and GRP-0425/0426 are INSIDE that 112 - retiring them leaves 109, not 111. And 27 unique pending = 29 minus exactly 2, and the only 2 whose removal is justified are the pending twins GRP-0402/0407. Therefore: KEEP the RUO row, RETIRE the pending twin; customer pays 49.00 and 59.00; both directly orderable. Asserted as three tests, so a different collapse turns the suite red rather than shipping quietly. Samuel can still overrule, but then BOTH targets move and the tests name it. (4) NOT MISPRICED TODAY: runtime carries only the pending twins (both approval_required); the RUO rows have no variant, which is also why the GRP-0422 hazard is still latent.
